status: Interactive local prototype; screenshots are recorded evidence

screens.title: Deal directory
screens.summary: One place to find the active opportunity.
capabilities: Find Harbor Components.
See stage, owner, quote range and next action.
screens.limit: One illustrative Deal; no Website Inbox or CRM sync.

screens.title: Deal overview
screens.summary: Keep the application, offers and next action together.
capabilities: Open either quote alternative.
See current proposal and unanswered questions.
Edit the follow-up owner and date.
screens.limit: The reviewed browser contains Harbor V1–V3; another profile starts with draft data.

screens.title: Shared requirements
screens.summary: Confirm the facts that both alternatives depend on.
capabilities: Review bag size, material, loading process and target.
Edit shared requirements; changed quotes require review.
screens.limit: A customer throughput target is not a performance guarantee.

screens.title: Quote builder
screens.summary: Configure A/B inside the complete Deal workspace.
capabilities: Switch between alternatives.
Create an explicit revision of a published quote.
Save working changes before approval.
screens.limit: Captured B Rev 2 is published and therefore read-only until revised.

screens.title: Standard loading
screens.summary: Keep the simpler alternative available for comparison.
capabilities: R3200 plus selected training.
Own revision and customer-facing note.
screens.limit: The screenshot records the current reviewed prototype; dated sample prices require PAC confirmation.

screens.title: Options and totals
capabilities: Opener requires fingers and bag width of at least 10 inches.
Selected equipment, services and engineering roll into the subtotal.
screens.limit: Detail crop of the published B screen. Initial A $33,060 / B $40,810; the reviewed B includes an illustrative $500 guide.

screens.title: Engineering scope
screens.summary: Keep unknown price and timing visible.
capabilities: Add explicit scope, customer price and additional weeks.
Incomplete engineering work prevents approval.
screens.limit: Detail crop. The $500 and one week shown are illustrative test inputs, not PAC-confirmed estimates.

screens.title: Draft customer preview
screens.summary: Review the customer presentation before publication.
capabilities: Preview working A/B configurations.
See the draft banner; customer questions are disabled.
screens.limit: A preview is not an issued customer version.

screens.title: Review and publication
screens.summary: Separate work in progress from the offer a customer sees.
capabilities: Open Review & publish.
Save and approve eligible alternatives.
Publish a frozen customer version.
screens.limit: The captured dialog shows already published revisions; approvals and publication are browser-local and send no email.

screens.title: Customer Proposal
screens.summary: Give the buyer a focused PAC-branded view.
capabilities: Read the application context.
Navigate between comparison, equipment and conversation.
Print through the browser Print / PDF action.
screens.limit: The customer-only route removes workspace controls; it is not remote access control. Open an existing publication in the same browser.

screens.title: A/B comparison
screens.summary: Explain what changes and what stays the same.
capabilities: Compare loading approaches, included scope and amounts.
Open line items and discuss an option.
screens.limit: Captured V3: A Rev 0 $33,060; B Rev 2 $41,310, including the illustrative guide. No final PAC offer is implied.

screens.title: Customer equipment details
screens.summary: Ask about the exact equipment detail under discussion.
capabilities: Switch PAC reference photographs.
Ask about this detail with option and topic context.
screens.limit: Reference photos are not an exact assembled configuration; internal Explorer findings are not automatically published here.

screens.title: Version-specific questions
screens.summary: Keep questions attached to the offer the buyer reviewed.
capabilities: Choose option and topic.
Send a question tied to the current version and revision.
screens.limit: Questions are saved in this browser. No email or remote customer service is connected.

screens.title: Sales activity and replies
screens.summary: Answer the question without reconstructing the context.
capabilities: Reply to a customer question.
Open its original proposal version.
Start a specific option revision when needed.
screens.limit: A reply and a new publication are separate actions.

screens.title: Published version history
screens.summary: Change the offer without rewriting the past.
capabilities: Open prior and current proposals.
Compare the exact revisions and amounts.
screens.limit: V1–V3 are evidence from the reviewed profile, not records that travel with a shared link.

screens.title: Explorer · PAC photographs
screens.summary: Keep a real equipment reference with the application question.
capabilities: Select equipment or detail.
Save a title, observation and related quote to the same Deal.
screens.limit: Saving a finding does not select options, change prices or publish internal notes.

screens.title: Explorer · interactive reference
screens.summary: Show how a specific view can stay with a question.
capabilities: Select, rotate, explode or operate the reference.
Capture and restore a view.
screens.limit: Generic crank-slider reference, not PAC equipment or PAC CAD. It cannot validate R3200 fit or clearance.

screens.title: Saved discoveries
screens.summary: Move from investigation to an explicit sales decision.
capabilities: Keep photo and 3D findings with Harbor.
Create a quote revision or link to a working quote.
Mark an addressed finding.
screens.limit: Internal Deal context only. The commercial revision uses PAC facts, not geometry inferred from the generic reference.

flows.title: Prepare a clear offer
flows.summary: Requirements → configure → save → review → publish → customer decision.

steps.expect: One Deal contains the application, alternatives and next action.
steps.say: We start with the customer’s process and the facts that change the quote.

steps.action: Review the 12 × 16 in bags, material and loading process.
steps.expect: Both alternatives use the same requirements.
steps.say: We can compare the loading approach fairly because the application is shared.

steps.action: Open Quotes. Compare A and B. If published, create a revision first. Make a real customer-facing note change, then save.
steps.expect: B adds the opener and required fingers. Price and scope stay explicit.
steps.say: The machine stays the same. The loading package and commercial scope change.

steps.action: Open Review & publish. Save and approve eligible alternatives, then publish.
steps.expect: A customer version preserves the reviewed scope and prices.
steps.say: Unfinished work stays a draft. The customer gets the reviewed offer.

steps.action: Open the new customer Proposal; compare options and line items.
steps.expect: Amounts and revision references match the published review.
steps.say: The buyer sees what is included, what changes and what still needs confirmation.

steps.action: Ask about the loading area in Option B.
steps.expect: The question keeps the proposal version, option, revision and topic.
steps.say: Sales receives a question with enough context to answer it.

flows.title: Turn a finding into a revision
flows.summary: Inspect → save a finding → revise explicitly → publish → reply → retain history.

steps.action: In Explorer, select PAC equipment photos → Loading & sealing area and Related quote B. Save a question about the guide and actual sample parts.
steps.expect: A PAC photo finding is attached to the same Deal and quote.
steps.say: The equipment reference and application question stay together.

steps.action: Optionally select Slider carriage, Explode, Capture current view, save and Restore view.
steps.expect: The reference interaction is captured; the actual commercial quote is unchanged.
steps.say: This shows the interaction. An approved PAC model would be needed to explain PAC geometry.

steps.action: Return to the PAC photo finding. Choose Create quote revision or Link to working quote.
steps.expect: B opens in explicit revision context; no option is added automatically.
steps.say: Sales decides when a discovery should become a change to the offer.

steps.action: Clarify the customer-facing note: PAC will review the actual bags and sample parts with Harbor before finalizing the loading guide scope. Preserve existing options and scope. Save, review and approve changed B, then publish.
steps.expect: A real clarification creates a new customer version; price can remain the same.
steps.say: We make the resolution explicit and review it again. Unknown scope or timing remains visible.

steps.action: Reply to the original customer question and refer to the actual new version.
steps.expect: The answer remains with the original version and question.
steps.say: Publishing does not finish the conversation. Sales still explains the resolution.

steps.action: Open the previous and new versions; return to Overview to set the next action.
steps.expect: Earlier prices, scope and questions remain available.
steps.say: We improve the offer without losing what the customer previously saw.

flows.prerequisite: Run Flow 1 first, or start with a published proposal and a customer question. Keep the same browser profile.
